Once on the top row, travel left toward your goal column, carefully staying above the areas with fires clustered near the bottom row. This corridor along the top edge allows you to avoid danger zones effectively. It is also helpful to practice slight variations of this path on the top row, as small detours can maintain safety while adapting to different fire placements. Demonstrating this route from various nearby starting points with different fire patterns will strengthen the ability to generalize this safe, long-range corridor strategy. This approach will help correct risky behaviors by reinforcing commitment to a secure, top-edge path before descending toward the goal.
